title: The Chameleon's Limit: Investigating Persona Collapse and Homogenization in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.24698v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have powered multi-agent simulations such as survey respondents or application users. However, LLMs lack the population-level diversity required by these simulations---responses from LLMs with detailed human profiles cluster into classes, unlike human responses that uniformly fill the entire space. In this paper, we formalize this as Persona Collapse and quantify its population-level structure with three diagnostic metrics: Coverage (how much of the persona space is occupied), Uniformity (how evenly agents spread across it), and Complexity (how rich the resulting behaviors are). Across eight LLMs on personality (BFI-44), moral reasoning, and self-introduction, persona collapse is universal but task-dependent: CoSER-Llama-8B collapses the most in personality while being the most diverse in moral reasoning. Moreover, sampling more personas cannot mitigate the collapse. We further show a fidelity--diversity

translated_title: 变色龙的极限：研究大语言模型中的人格坍缩与同质化现象
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已被用于驱动多智能体模拟，例如模拟问卷调查受访者或应用程序用户。然而，大语言模型缺乏这些模拟所需的人群级多样性——带有详细人类画像的LLM，其响应会聚集成少数几类，而不像人类响应那样均匀地填满整个空间。在本文中，我们将这一现象形式化为“人格坍缩”（Persona Collapse），并用三个诊断指标来量化其人群级结构：覆盖度（人格空间被占据了多少）、均匀度（智能体在空间中分布的均匀程度）和复杂度（由此产生的行为有多丰富）。在八个大语言模型上，针对人格（BFI-44）、道德推理和自我介绍任务的实验表明，人格坍缩是普遍存在的，但依赖于具体任务：CoSER-Llama-8B在人格任务上坍缩最严重，却在道德推理上最具多样性。此外，采样更多的人格画像无法缓解这种坍缩。我们进一步展示了保真度—多样性（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次将大语言模型在多智能体模拟中响应趋于同质化的现象形式化为“人格坍缩”，提出覆盖度、均匀度、复杂度三个诊断指标，发现该现象普遍存在但因任务而异，且无法通过增加人格采样来缓解。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes the homogenization of LLM responses in multi-agent simulations as "Persona Collapse," introduces three diagnostic metrics—Coverage, Uniformity, and Complexity—and shows that the collapse is universal yet task-dependent and cannot be mitigated by sampling more personas.
